Class SocketView

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.client.view.VirtualView
mesos.am30.client.view.SocketView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Remote, IF_GameView
public class SocketView extends VirtualView
Socket communication handler View-side.
This Class works as the communication logic for the VirtualView Class, handling all the View commands and sending them to the Controller.
It implements the communication protocol via Socket.

    • findServer

      public void findServer(String path, int port) throws IOException
      Open the connection to the Server.
      This method manages the Socket connection between this View and the Server.
      Pre: path != null
      Post: socket = Socket(path, port) && outputStream = socket.getOutputStream && inputStream = socket.getInputStream
      Specified by:
      findServer in class VirtualView
      Parameters:
      path - URL of the Server.
      port - Port opened by the Server.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.
      See Also:
